review.notes: Automated line-level comparison of extracted text from all 15 physical PDF pages against the OCR Markdown, plus a code-fence balance scan (no fences present) and a heading scan. All five printed figures (Figure 1 split into two images, Figures 2-5) are embedded with their captions. Text flagged on pages 1, 4, 5, 7 and 10 (diagram labels, attention-mask legend, category chart labels) exists only inside the embedded figures; math-flagged lines on pages 3, 5-9 and 11 are present in the OCR in LaTeX/reflowed form, including both numbered equations and their surrounding explanations. Equation (1) on page 7 was rendered at 300 dpi: the PDF itself prints "where n = m" (inconsistent with the (m+n)x(m+n) mask, but an author typo that the OCR reproduces faithfully, so it is kept). Table data values were compared page by page; Table 1-3 values match.

patches.evidence: Physical p.3 span inspection (PyMuPDF font dump, visually cross-checked layout) shows "Our main contributions are threefold:" is set in regular URWPalladioL-Roma at body size 10.9, while real section headings such as "Related Works" on the same page use URWPalladioL-Bold. The line is a body paragraph lead-in ending in a colon, not a printed heading; the OCR promoted it to an H2.

unresolved.evidence: Table 1-3 headers flatten printed subscripts: V-token_max, Formula_CDM, Table_TEDs, R-order_Edit, Text_Edit are transcribed as "V-tokenmax", "FormulaCDM", "TableTEDs", "R-orderEdit", "TextEdit". The characters are all present and cell values match; restoring subscript formatting needs an exporter-side convention, so it is recorded rather than patched.
